# Mockport

Mockport is a secret-free, Docker-first local API environment for AI coding agents and CI.

## Start here

- README and quickstart: README.md, docs/site/quickstart.md
- Current support: docs/site/support-matrix.md
- Known limitations: docs/site/limitations.md
- Runnable official SDK clients: examples/node-sdk-clients/
- Adapter specifications: docs/adapters/
- Contribution and TDD: CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/maintainer-guide.md

## Security boundary

- Never use real provider credentials with Mockport examples or tests.
- Use only `mockport_`-prefixed fake values and loopback URLs.
- Do not proxy requests to real provider APIs.
- Run `make verify` before proposing changes.
- Treat `docs/planning/` as planning input, not current support or a release commitment.

## Runtime contract

- Health: GET /health
- Machine-readable report: GET /_mockport/report
- Default local address: http://127.0.0.1:43101
- Built-in adapters: Stripe, OpenAI, GitHub OAuth, Slack, LINE, Zoho OAuth
